title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.1.1 RC1
summary: Transfer recovery and folder edge-case fixes, plus a clean bitmap preview when rearranging computer tiles.
changes: Recover paused transfers after recovery-file write failures, and recover a missing journal from its backup.
Verify loose-file destination identities before resuming or cleaning up.
Retry temporarily unreadable scanned files using safely refreshed metadata.
Compact finished rows into bounded completion receipts and budget space for admitted transfers.
Reuse receiving buffers and avoid redundant completion checkpoints.
Replace live computer-tile dragging with a painted preview to prevent trails and clipped child controls.
testing: Windows Release x64 build and automated regression suite must pass before publication.
Use this candidate on both PCs. Test paused/resumed folder copies, cancellation, a locked source file, and rearranging the matrix in one and two rows.
Hardware sleep/wake, network interruption and real Explorer interaction still require owner validation.
known_limitations: One self-contained, unsigned Windows x64 EXE; no Windows service or protected-desktop support.
Full-speed copies can still compete with mouse sharing on busy Wi-Fi.
Folder copies can partially complete. Unsupported links and unreadable directories require a fresh drag.
Recovery records now include compact receipts; keep backups and avoid downgrading while transfers are unfinished.
